All spectra, geometric equivalences, 18/48 counts and witnesses follow without approximation. A fresh exact-rational executable enumerates and confirms every case and the full projector identity. The explicit trace-difference witness is checked on all 36 ordered half-turn deletion pairs.

Related published record summaries concern different representations or geometries. Historical frame-erasure priority remains a genuine risk.
